text: I am glad that you decided to direct your attention for a month and purposefully work on the theme uniting such states as: pleasures, relaxation, blissfulness, playfulness, attractiveness, sexuality... They seem to be simple states accessible to everyone. However, in society there are many both motivating and prohibitive scenarios that control our behavior. By doing practices on the yoga mat and in life, reflecting, adjusting your thoughts and actions, over the course of a month you can get important results that will manifest both at the level of the body (healing) and at the level of the psychological background (satisfaction and happiness).
